reviews.title: Samsung 34” ViewFinity S5 Ultrawide QHD Monitor
reviews.comment:
The Samsung 34” ViewFinity S5 Ultrawide QHD Monitor delivers excellent value for productivity and entertainment. Its Ultra‑WQHD resolution, 100Hz refresh rate, and AMD FreeSync make multitasking smooth and gaming tear‑free. Colors look vibrant with HDR10, and the ultrawide 21:9 format provides a spacious, immersive workspace.

The design is sleek, though the stand only tilts and lacks height adjustment. Connectivity is solid with HDMI and DisplayPort, but the absence of USB‑C is a drawback for laptop users. Overall, it’s a strong, affordable ultrawide monitor that shines in everyday use, streaming, and casual gaming.

reviews.title: good, but curved display would be better
reviews.comment:
decent image quality
good price
mainly use for photo processing and business type apps
However, I found after I purchased that I could have bought a curved monitor of equal size for just a little more. That would be better. There's a lot of scanning side to side with this, and with my old eyes refocusing can be a challenge. I'm a lot further from the edges than from the middle. 
the big negative though is that the physical controls in the bottom center are difficult to use. Tiny buttons, not visible, so you have to find them by touch, I switch between two PCs and its quite a pain.
